full_judgment: The opposite party Nos. 1-10 as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 17 of 2001 before the court of Assistant Judge, Barguna Sadar, Barguna against the petitioner along with proforma opposite party Nos. 11-72 impleading them as defendants for declaration of title and on 16-9-2003 the said title suit No. 17 of 2001 in the court of Assistant Judge, Barguna Sadar was decreed in terms of a Solenama with Opposite Party No. 46 (the defendant No. 41 in title suit No. 17 of 2001) and ex-parte against the rest.
